title: Computers with built-in graphics stop crashing in 1904
items: A computer whose graphics are built into the processor (Intel UHD, Iris, AMD Radeon Graphics) shares one pool of memory between the town and the picture. Such a computer now opens at Balanced detail with softer textures, and keeps each building once instead of twice, as a phone does. People, horses, carriages and wagons all stay. Before, it opened 1904 at Full and the browser tab could crash.
The observatory's device rating counts that shared memory, so such a computer now reads Low and says "shared memory", where before it read Good.
A computer that has crashed here also keeps the lighter memory use until you choose Scene detail and Sharpness in Settings yourself.
